plugins.name: Veil
plugins.description: Swaps secrets and personal data in model requests for reversible placeholders before they reach upstream providers, and restores the original values in responses, streamed or not.
plugins.author: GarlandQian

zh-CN.description: 在模型请求到达上游之前，把密钥和个人信息换成可还原的占位符，并在回复（包括流式回复）中换回原值。
